title: Tox-BART: Leveraging Toxicity Attributes for Explanation Generation of Implicit Hate Speech
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical architecture (Tox-BART) for explaining implicit hate speech. While the research uses datasets containing religious and social stereotypes (like SBIC and StereoKG) and mentions social norms, it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or ethical frameworks themselves as its primary objective.
